# The engine's `idempotency-sales-tax-pay-v1` route set (U-150, P23 plan §2.0): Pay Sales Tax, linking an outside payment, unlink and mark paid through,
# `x-idempotency: true` in its openapi.json. Client-declared until the WP-4
# pin bump. Append-only for this capability name: `keyable-sales-tax-pay` in operations.txt
# (`KeySet::SalesTaxPayV1`), keyed only while the engine advertises
# `idempotency-sales-tax-pay-v1`.
POST /api/v1/sales-tax/payments
POST /api/v1/sales-tax/payments/link
POST /api/v1/sales-tax/payments/{id}/unlink
POST /api/v1/sales-tax/payments/mark-paid-through
